CustomField.description: Gitlab : 10081, Update Forecast Billing Line Validation Rule to When Moving from Stage 4 to Stage 5. This field helps to verify each sales billing forecast record' sales billing estimated value is populated with > 0. If min value is < 1, then we should not allow users to move opportunity from Stage 4 to Stage 5.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Gets min value of Sales Billing Estimate from Sales Billing Forecast records.
CustomField.label: Min Of Sales Billing Estimate
